summary: A racer in CB Nordic's 17th Annual Gothic Mountain Tour suffered a broken ankle on the race course (over the Washington Gulch drainage) and had to be transported out; Crested Butte Search and Rescue president Randy Felix confirmed the team evacuated the injured participant that winter.
location: Gothic Mountain Tour course, Washington Gulch / Gothic corridor, near Crested Butte
notes: Run 874: resolves run-851 parked lead #1 of 3 winter 2022-23 unnamed missions; date pinned from race-day report (Sunday, February 19 + /2023/02/ URL; 2023-02-19 was a Sunday). Cement Creek dislocated-hip and Friend's Hut cardiac leads stay parked (undateable).
